script.problem: Moment 2's passage Numbers 13:25-30 doesn't include a verse that names Brook Eshcol in the lessons.

terra.problem: “The report back to Israel” takes place at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Paran, not at the Valley of Eshcol.
“Remembered as a time of fear” describes Moses recalling the spies’ visit and its aftermath, not events that all happened at Eshcol.

“That generation wandered forty years, except Caleb and Joshua” could suggest that Caleb and Joshua did not wander. They were exceptions to the judgment that the generation would not enter the land, not to the wilderness wandering.
